in_hebrew.name: Gillett
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Pledge, hostage, or stranger
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gillett הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Old English word 'gield' meaning 'payment' or 'pledge'. The name Gillett may have originated from the idea of a hostage or stranger, someone given as a guarantee or pledge. In the context of the Christian faith, this name can symbolize a commitment to one's faith and a willingness to serve as a witness for God.
